messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD_PROXY_5xx (high) -> ~35 x 5xx in last 2m for POST /v1/embed on region=us-west-2, route=embed-edge-canary-2026-03-14. Paging @maya (oncall) and @jack (oncall2). Please ack.

deploy-bot: Rolling update started: rev=2026.03.14-rc1 -> edge-proxy-canary (strategy=staggered, rollout_id=roll-7782). Sidecar image=proxy-filter:v2.

maya (oncall): acked. i'm on it. @raj fyi — you pushed proxy-filter:v2 in this rollout?

sre-bot: auto-metrics snapshot -> p50=120ms p95=450ms p99=1.8s error_rate=5.6% (5xx) traffic_to_canary=4% recent_spike=20s ago

maya (oncall): pulling logs from canary pods now. seeing repeated `upstream reset` and timeouts to tokenizer-service.

raj (eng): yeah that matches the change set — small connection pooling tweak in proxy-filter:v2. can you run `kubectl logs -l app=edge-proxy-canary -c sidecar --tail=200`?

maya (oncall): logs (snippet):
```
[edge-proxy-canary] 2026-03-14T21:12:45Z ERROR upstream reset: connection refused to 10.12.33.9:8000
[edge-proxy-canary] 2026-03-14T21:12:46Z ERROR deadline exceeded waiting for response from tokenizer-service
[edge-proxy-canary] 2026-03-14T21:12:47Z WARN retrying request, attempt=2
```

ellie (support): getting customer reports: ACME corp (enterprise) filed 7 hits with 500s to embed endpoint in last 10m. CS alerted and we told them we're investigating.

maya (oncall): traffic routing note: fallback pool already receiving some reroutes. i'm going to pause the rollout and divert new traffic away from the canary. running: `redwood rollout pause roll-7782 --scope=edge-proxy-canary`

deploy-bot: rollout roll-7782 paused at 37% across clusters. pause acknowledged.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalated to SRE lead (5m elapsed since page) due to ongoing 5xxs and partial mitigation.

jack (oncall2): joining thread. brief look — looks like v2's connection pooling reduces max connections during short bursts which causes upstream resets under concurrent warmup. we should rollback sidecar on the canary ASAP.

raj (eng): agree. plan: rollback sidecar to proxy-filter:v1 on canary only (hotpatch). command: `kubectl set image ds/edge-sidecar-canary sidecar=proxy-filter:v1 -n prod` (will push image update).

maya (oncall): do it. i'll watch metrics and error rates. notify CS when we see improvement.

raj (eng): applying rollback now...
`deployment.apps/edge-sidecar-canary image updated`

sre-bot: note: pod restarts +12% during spike, kv-cache warm ratio steady. autoscaler stable.

maya (oncall): metrics update after rollback: p50=110ms p95=260ms p99=900ms error_rate=0.9% (5xx). trending down.

ellie (support): CS update: notified ACME with incident id RID-3344. they requested ETA — told them ~15-30m for verification and followup.

maya (oncall): PD ack by maya. marking as mitigated for now. keeping thread open for 30m to confirm stability. handing off to @raj for RCA and postmortem.

raj (eng): will create PMT ticket and include: reproduction steps, root cause (proxy-filter:v2 connection pooling regression under short bursts), remediation (rollback, fixed pooling logic), and tests (load test for short burst concurrency). creating PMT-4521 now.

maya (oncall): short summary for runbook: cause=sidecar v2 connection-pool regression; impact=5xx for ~8 minutes on canary; scope=~4% traffic, some customer 500s; mitigation=paused rollout + rollback on canary; next=block v2 until fix + add e2e load test.

jack (oncall2): checklist: 1) keep v2 blocked from canary/promo 2) monitor p99 for 1h 3) if reappearance, escalate and revert globally.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved: PROD_PROXY_5xx -> resolved_by=maya (oncall) -> duration=12m

maya (oncall): closing pager loop. will follow up with RCA draft in PMT-4521 and schedule a brief postmortem sync. :white_check_mark:
